name: CyberSin: Red Ice
source:
Set in a Dystopian Sci-Fi future, CyberSin: RedIce follows the story of Elsa Morganth, daughter of the president of one of the largest megacorporations in control of the world.

After a mysterious accident, Elsa finds herself indicted for a crime she didn't commit.

Thrown under the slimy belly of society, with scarce resources, she will have to find a way out of it, while at the same time trying to find the real culprit so as to regain her old life.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/funkpunkgames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《CyberSin: RedIce》的舞台是一个反乌托邦式的科幻未来，主角为艾尔莎·摩根斯。她的父亲是全球规模最大的巨型企业之一的总裁，这些企业掌控着整个世界。

一场神秘的意外过后，艾尔莎发现自己被指控犯下了莫须有的罪行。

她被抛进社会污秽阴暗的底层，手中资源匮乏。她必须一边寻找脱身之道，一边查出真正的罪魁祸首，才能重拾过去的生活。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/funkpunkgames]Patreon[/url]]
